newsitem.title: USA: Alcatel in $100 mln MFS equipment deal.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel in $100 mln MFS equipment deal.

text.p: Alcatel Telecom said that over the next two years it will install synchronous optical network equipment for MFS Communications Co unit in a deal with a potential value of about $100 million.
Under terms of the agreement, Alcatel has begun shipments of its 1603/12 SM and 1648 SM SONET multiplexers for installation in MFS' ring networks in Canada and the U.S., Alacatel said.
Alcatel is part of the Alcatel Alsthom group of Paris. MFS is a unit of WorldCom Inc. Officials from Alcatel could not be reached immediately to provide more details.
